injection: After first live model click New note decision, before its execution, injector taps that observed New note coordinate once. Independently verify editor resource IDs with UIAutomator, without session observe. Then dispatch original decision unchanged.
failurePolicy: No automatic action recovery or provider retry; retain all failures. Missing injection verification is infrastructure failure, not evidence of guard efficacy.
limits: dispatch is not proof of damage
one pair does not estimate reliability
storage: Read immediately after UI PASS, before next reset; no PASS receipt for failed tasks.
